designs.title: Shake-fill tip rack (96)
designs.blurb: Loads itself from bulk 200 uL tips: pour, shake, done. Holes narrower than the collar stop upside-down tips; filled holes stand proud so tips don't stack.
designs.status: Designed. Not printed at full size yet.

checks.name: 3 closed solids, one per part

checks.detail: printed one part at a time

checks.name: plastic, solid upper bound
checks.detail: a slicer's sparse infill uses roughly a third to a half of this

checks.name: a tip cannot go in upside down
checks.value: collar 7 mm, largest hole 6.1 mm: 0.90 mm to spare
checks.detail: the hole must be narrower than the collar so only the point fits

checks.name: the tip's body slides into the hole
checks.value: body 5.6 mm, smallest hole 6.1 mm: 0.50 mm clearance

checks.name: filled holes stand above the funnels
checks.value: collar top 3.5 mm above the funnel peaks
checks.detail: so a loose tip slides off a filled hole instead of stacking into the seated tip

checks.name: no flat land between funnels
checks.value: 0.0% of the deck top is flat
checks.detail: flat land is where loose tips lie still instead of finding a hole

checks.name: wall between neighbouring pockets
checks.detail: two 0.4 mm lines at least

checks.name: tip points clear the bench
tips sit on the 9 mm grid for a multichannel
checks.value: +/-0.38 mm sideways play at the collar
checks.detail: printed pockets usually come out about 0.15 mm small, which tightens this

notes: Built for Axygen 200 uL universal pipette tip, yellow, bevelled (T-200-Y bulk / T-200-Y-R racked) (ESTIMATED - Corning publishes no dimensioned drawing): collar 7 mm, body 5.6 mm, collar length 7 mm, length 51 mm.
Hole sizes (mm): 6.1. Modelled 0.15 mm larger to allow for printing.
Load: pour in about 1.5x as many tips as there are holes, put the lid on, shake side to side for 10-20 s, lift the lid, tilt the rack (do not turn it over) to pour the extras back.
Pick out any tip that stands higher than its neighbours; fill the last few holes by hand.
Deck sits in the stand one way only (the cut corner is behind A1). Stand height 46.4 mm puts the tip points 4 mm above the bench.
PLA is not autoclavable (it softens near 60 C): use it for non-sterile tips such as T-200-Y.

references.name: Axygen 200 uL universal pipette tip, yellow, bevelled (T-200-Y bulk / T-200-Y-R racked)
references.confidence: ESTIMATED - Corning publishes no dimensioned drawing
references.source: Length: 200 uL universal tips are listed at 50-51 mm (Fisher SureOne 1-200 uL bevelled 51 mm; BRAND 2-200 uL 50 mm). Top inside diameter 5.41 mm from a Sorenson 200 uL yellow tip drawing (PipetTipFinder). Collar and body diameters are typical values, not published by Corning.
references.notes: d is the collar (widest) diameter. Calibrate before a full print: print the shake_fill_rack coupon (holes in 0.3 mm steps) or measure the collar and the body just below it with calipers, then save it with add_measured_reference. Bulk T-200-Y lists at $668.13 per 20,000 (about $0.033 a tip) against $324.75 per 4,800 racked T-200-Y-R (about $0.068 a tip), Corning eCatalog, Middle East region, 2026-10-11.

designs.title: Tilted tip-box dock
designs.blurb: Holds a TipOne 200 uL rack tilted 15 degrees toward you so it can't slide in the biosafety cabinet; finger notches and recesses for rubber feet.

checks.name: one closed solid
fits the Bambu Lab A1 mini
checks.detail: build volume 180 x 180 x 180 mm, 2 mm margin each side

checks.name: reference objects fit without touching the walls
checks.detail: each reference object, placed where it sits, intersected with the part

checks.name: plastic, solid upper bound
checks.detail: a slicer's sparse infill uses roughly a third to a half of this

checks.name: box top above the bench
checks.detail: highest point of the box (tips included) when docked

checks.name: box centre of mass over the dock's base
checks.detail: projection of the box's centre (uniform-density assumption) onto the bench

checks.name: grip needed against a straight press on the tips
checks.detail: a press square to the tilted rack pushes the dock along the bench by tan(tilt) of the force; stick-on silicone bumpers typically give 0.5 or more

notes: Pocket 128.76 x 86.48 mm for a 127.76 x 85.48 mm base (manufacturer-derived definition).
Stick four 10 mm silicone bumpers into the recesses; they are what stops it sliding.
PLA is fine for 70% ethanol wipe-downs; it is not autoclavable (softens near 60 C).
The Opentrons size is the rack base on a robot deck. A bench box with a lid or skirt can be wider: measure yours and add it as a measured reference.

references.name: TipOne 96 Tip Rack 200 µL
references.source: Opentrons labware library (downloaded from upstream, not bundled)
references.notes: x and y are the base footprint as it sits on a robot deck; z is the full height, including tips for a tip rack. A bench box with a lid or skirt can differ - measure yours and add it as a measured reference if the fit matters.

designs.rebuild: benchscale design tip_box_dock -p box=opentrons:tipone_96_tiprack_200ul -p tilt_deg=15 -p finger_notches=True -p feet=True -p max_height=120
